versions.subject: feat: Add new rule for Creative Cloud node abuse
versions.detection:
selection:
    Image|endswith: '\Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\libs\node.exe'
filter:
    CommandLine|contains: 'Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\js' # Folder where Creative Cloud's JS resources are located
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: Image="*\\Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\\libs\\node.exe" NOT CommandLine="*Adobe Creative Cloud Experience\\js*"
